form.label: COO — Operational Resilience & Incident Response
form.description: Links security operations to business continuity: system availability vs. SLA, detection/response speed, incident backlog, and third-party operational risk. Drill down: KPI -> Business Unit -> System -> Outage/Incident Event.

search.query: | inputlookup uptime_availability.csv | dedup business_unit | table business_unit | sort business_unit
| inputlookup uptime_availability.csv | where business_unit=$tok_bu$ OR "$tok_bu$"="*" | stats avg(uptime_pct) as avg_uptime | eval avg_uptime=round(avg_uptime,3)
| inputlookup uptime_availability.csv | where (business_unit=$tok_bu$ OR "$tok_bu$"="*") AND customer_impact="Y" | stats count as outages
| inputlookup security_incidents.csv | where business_unit=$tok_bu$ OR "$tok_bu$"="*" | stats avg(mttd_hours) as mttd | eval mttd=round(mttd,1)
| inputlookup security_incidents.csv | where business_unit=$tok_bu$ OR "$tok_bu$"="*" | stats avg(mttr_hours) as mttr | eval mttr=round(mttr,1)
| inputlookup security_incidents.csv | where (business_unit=$tok_bu$ OR "$tok_bu$"="*") AND status!="Resolved" | stats count as backlog

panel.title: Weekly Availability Trend vs. SLA Target

search.query: | inputlookup uptime_availability.csv | where business_unit=$tok_bu$ OR "$tok_bu$"="*" | stats avg(uptime_pct) as avg_uptime avg(sla_target_pct) as sla_target by week_start | sort week_start

panel.title: Incident Backlog by Severity Over Time

search.query: | inputlookup security_incidents.csv | where business_unit=$tok_bu$ OR "$tok_bu$"="*" | eval month=strftime(strptime(date,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),"%Y-%m") | stats count by month, severity

panel.title: Downtime Minutes by Business Unit (click a bar to drill in)

search.query: | inputlookup uptime_availability.csv | where business_unit=$tok_bu$ OR "$tok_bu$"="*" | stats sum(downtime_minutes) as downtime_minutes count(eval(customer_impact="Y")) as customer_impacting_events by business_unit | sort -downtime_minutes

panel.title: Third-Party / Vendor Operational Risk (SLA breaches & incidents)

search.query: | inputlookup vendor_risk.csv | where business_unit=$tok_bu$ OR "$tok_bu$"="*" | sort -sla_breach_count | table vendor_name, business_unit, criticality, sla_breach_count, incident_count, risk_score | head 8

panel.title: Systems in "$sel_bu$" by Downtime (click a bar to drill into that system's outage events)

search.query: | inputlookup uptime_availability.csv | where business_unit="$sel_bu$" | stats sum(downtime_minutes) as downtime_minutes avg(uptime_pct) as avg_uptime by system | sort -downtime_minutes

| inputlookup uptime_availability.csv | where business_unit="$sel_bu$" AND (system="$sel_sys$" OR "$sel_sys$"="") AND outage_cause!="" | sort -week_start | table week_start, system, uptime_pct, sla_target_pct, downtime_minutes, outage_cause, customer_impact

panel.title: Related Security Incidents — "$sel_bu$" $sel_sys$ (deepest drill: raw incident record)

search.query: | inputlookup security_incidents.csv | where business_unit="$sel_bu$" AND (system="$sel_sys$" OR "$sel_sys$"="") | sort -date | table incident_id, date, severity, category, mttd_hours, mttr_hours, status, root_cause

html.p: Drill-down path: Availability / MTTD-MTTR tiles (Row 1) → Business Unit downtime (Row 3, click a bar) → System within that unit (Row 4, click a bar) → raw outage weeks and the specific incident records that caused them (Row 5). The same system and business_unit fields join directly to the CIO dashboard's SOC alert and vulnerability data for full technical root-cause detail.
